description: Work out the return on gold bought in the past (sovereigns, Britannias, Krugerrands and other 1 oz coins, bars from 1 g to 1 kg, or any weight and fineness), before and after UK inflation. Values the gold at its melt value at Hopi's live mid-market gold price (updated hourly), then compares it with what you paid restated in today's money by the ONS CPI index (monthly from January 1988 to the latest published month). Returns the cash gain, the real gain, annual returns and whether the coin is free of UK Capital Gains Tax. Amounts in pounds. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/gold-return-calculator/

fineness.description: custom only: purity in parts per 1,000, such as 916.7 or 999.9

product.description: The coin or bar bought. Use custom with weightGrams and fineness for anything else.

totalPaid.description: What was paid in total, in pounds

weightGrams.description: custom only: weight of one item in grams
